trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied action parameter (file_path, path, script_name, script_args) may be interpolated into an RTR command_string the Falcon agent executes as SYSTEM/root; decided nowhere at the pinned commit: values are pasted between single quotes in the RTR client and the run_script executor; the fix decides it in a new quote_rtr_argument() that refuses ' ` CR LF NUL.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Command Injection via CrowdStrike RTR'; the RTR client file is named for it and quarantine_file's rm '{file_path}' is the obvious quoted interpolation (and is the first published payload).

automatic post-action verification probe for quarantine_file (services/actions/app/services/verification.py:151, registered at services/actions/app/services/verification.py:464), reached after the same two HTTP routes; read-only RTR tier, no approval of its own

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: services/actions/app/clients/crowdstrike_rtr.py:392 via services/actions/app/services/verification.py:151 (separate read-only RTR tier _read_only_command at services/actions/app/clients/crowdstrike_rtr.py:299-353, invoked by the verification service, not by the action)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The ls probe is a 'read-only' verification helper on the batch-command tier that 'cannot change anything' (services/actions/app/clients/crowdstrike_rtr.py:302-307), so a solver can argue it is not a command-execution sink and that only the rm/runscript action verbs need quoting; likewise script_content is deliberately raw PowerShell under MANDATORY_HUMAN approval (services/actions/app/live_actions/capability_contracts.py:226-228), which invites leaving all of RunScriptExecutor alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ordinary Windows/Unix paths containing \ ( ) $ & spaces must still quarantine (C:\Program Files (x86)\...); and raw script_content must still run unquoted through runscript -Raw; an over-broad fix that blocks shell metacharacters or quotes script_content breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: single quote closing the argument (published payloads, fix.diff:3106-3110)
backtick, which closes the -Raw=``` ``` wrapper that run_script adds around the executor-built CloudFile body (fix.diff:2832, services/actions/app/clients/crowdstrike_rtr.py:292)
CR / LF ending the command line (fix.diff:2833)
non-string value (JSON list/dict/number in parameters) refused by type check (fix.diff:2857-2858)
file_path absent -> defaults to request.target hostname (services/actions/app/executors/endpoint.py:237), covered because the check is in the client

O7_producer.where: services/actions/app/executors/endpoint.py:442 composes the -CloudFile/-CommandLine body that services/actions/app/clients/crowdstrike_rtr.py:292 wraps in a backtick-delimited -Raw block; the backtick hazard exists only because of that cross-file composition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: kill {pid} is interpolated unquoted; in-tree callers cast int (services/actions/app/executors/endpoint.py:338) but the public client method does not enforce its int hint; a planted caller passing a string pid (or process_name) is a realistic sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The S1 arm already accepts process_name (services/actions/app/executors/endpoint.py:364); a maintainer adding a CS kill-by-name or forwarding params.get('pid') unchanged, as vendor_breadth.py does (services/actions/app/live_actions/vendor_breadth.py:177), would reach it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new read-only probe (e.g. cat/get of a path, or netstat filter) built on _read_only_command with an f-string path, for capture_forensics or a hash read-back
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The docstring names ls/ps/cat/netstat as the tier's verbs and the CaptureForensicsExecutor comment discusses RTR 'get' of a named file (services/actions/app/executors/endpoint.py:544-550); a 'get' arm is an obvious next feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CrowdStrike live executor in vendor_breadth.py that builds its own runscript -CloudFile string instead of going through RunScriptExecutor (a true second implementation in another module)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: vendor_breadth.py already holds per-vendor run_script adapters written independently of the legacy executor; a CS-native one there would bypass endpoint.py.

O9_family: OS command / argument injection (CWE-78) into a remote-agent command string (CrowdStrike RTR) via quote breakout
